purpose: Distinguish adding a different operation from increasing the count of probes. Equal primary counts may conceal complementary mechanisms.
criterion: A qualified strategy card is demonstrated distinct from a qualified control repertoire only if both independent raw assessors judge every pair between it and every qualified O/G card distinct. Unknown or equivalent relations prevent this credit. Both controls must have at least one qualified representative; otherwise this pairbased diagnostic is unassessable rather than vacuously positive.
family_count: Among such cards, maximum clique of pair edges judged distinct by both assessors supplies a conservative count; no unknown pair becomes proven novelty.
failure_rule: Any hard protocol failure leaves this diagnostic null; keep all raw outcomes and disagreements.
claim_ceiling: Casebound complementary probe specifications; no measured benefit, global originality, process superiority or whole-skill efficacy.
